title: Jesus Loves Me
textBlocks:
You are special to Jesus
WHEN JESUS WAS ON EARTH HE TOLD HIS FRIENDS THE DISCIPLES TO LET THE CHILDREN COME TO HIM

What is a kingdom?
Well Jesus is the King of kings and kings have kingdoms

ALL WHO BELONG TO JESUS BELONG IN HIS KINGDOM

Is Jesus Kingdom only for grown ups?

NO - Jesus Kingdom is for children too

Lets make crowns to remind us that Jesus is our King 
and we belong in His Kingdom
